title: Pleiotropic Endothelial Stabilization by HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibitors
pre_discovery_prompt: Lipid-lowering HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors show mortality reductions in acute sepsis models independent of cholesterol levels. What vascular cellular mechanism drives this benefit?
ground_truth_finding: Upregulation of endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS) and inhibition of Rho kinase pathway leading to reduced vascular permeability and neutrophil extravasation.
notes_on_reconstruction: Genericized pre-discovery prompt stripping specific drug brand names.
